name: questions.devops_cicd.baseline
description: Baseline questions for source control, CI/CD pipeline, deployment cadence, and rollback.

questions.text: Which source-control platform hosts the codebase?
questions.rationale: Platform drives integration patterns for CI/CD, code scanning, and identity.

questions.text: Which CI/CD system runs builds and deploys?
questions.rationale: CI/CD system dictates what platform skills and migration complexity to expect.

questions.text: How often do you deploy the main production workload?
questions.rationale: Deploy frequency is the single strongest correlate of delivery maturity (DORA metrics).

questions.text: Do automated tests gate production deploys?
questions.rationale: Gating pressure is the difference between a safety net and theatre.

questions.text: What is the rollback / forward-fix strategy for a bad production release?
questions.rationale: A tested rollback path is evidence of real operational maturity.

questions.text: Is the deployment pipeline fully automated from merge to production?
options: Merge triggers staging, manual gate to prod
questions.rationale: Manual handoffs predict long lead time and human-error incident patterns.
